THE €1,500 OPEN SECRET
The average relocation strategy session costs €1,500 — just to be told the same thing every other client is told.

The international structures consultants recommend aren't bespoke. They're a short, repeatable list — UAE freezone, Paraguayan residency, Cypriot non-dom, Georgian territorial — wrapped in a suit and an hourly rate. Consultancies sell the same playbook to every founder who walks in. We just wrote it down.

OUR EDITORIAL STANCE
A different kind of relocation publication.
01
Legal, not loophole

Every framework we cover is grounded in OECD-recognised treaties, EU directives, and statutory regimes. No grey zones, no shell games.

02
Substance over secrecy

Real residency, real ties, real life. The era of hiding money is over. The era of intelligently choosing where to live has only just begun.

03
Operator-grade information

Written by people who built relocation files inside private banks for a decade. Not journalists. Not hobbyists. Operators.

FEATURED JURISDICTIONS
Four to start your research.
VIEW ALL 12 →
SOUTH AMERICA
Paraguay
Pure territorial taxation. 0% on foreign income for residents. The cheapest path to a real tax residency.
Tax
0% foreign / 10% local
MIDDLE EAST
United Arab Emirates
0% personal income tax. 9% corporate tax above AED 375,000 with free zone exemptions for qualifying companies.
Tax
0% personal / 0–9% corporate
CAUCASUS
Georgia
1% turnover tax for individual entrepreneurs (under 500K GEL revenue). Foreign-source income generally exempt with carve-outs. Quick setup, EU-adjacent.
Tax
1% small business / 20% standard
MEDITERRANEAN EU
Cyprus
60-day non-dom residency. 0% tax on dividends and interest under non-dom status for up to 17 years.
Tax
0–35% / 0% non-dom dividends
